_doc: ANIMATE-BUILDING-1 -- a witness for the animated-building defect class.
WHY THIS EXISTS: code/terrobj.cpp's own comment says the
animStartInvalidated counter 'may be zero in smoke missions if no
registered-static building animates'. That is an admission that a whole
render path -- the one the user's black quads AND sunk turrets both live
on -- has never once been exercised, because a passive fly-through never
makes a building animate. This scenario makes one animate on purpose.
REQUIRED ENV:
MC2_UI_COMMAND_FILE=<path>   the channel
MC2_TEST_SPAWN=1             arms `animate` (test-only world mutation)
MC2_SMOKE_FIXED_TIMESTEP=1   for a reproducible before/after pair
HOW TO USE IT: run it once and READ THE ACK. `list buildings` prints every
building with its animGestures (which gesture slots actually have
animation data), staticReg, recipe, staticNow and eligible. Pick a real
id + gesture from that output and substitute them below -- the ids here
are placeholders, and building part ids are POSITION-DERIVED
(MIN_TERRAIN_PART_ID + vertex*width + block), not sequential, so they
differ per mission.
THE TWO ROUTES OFF THE STATIC BATCH ARE DIFFERENT, AND BOTH ARE TESTED:
animate <id> <gesture>  -> setGesture() explicitly calls
invalidateStaticRegistration() on the idle->animated edge.
animate <id> damaged    -> setObjStatus() swaps in bldgDmgShape and does
NOT invalidate; the stale staticReg.shape != bldgShape is dropped a
frame LATER from render(). That one-frame window is itself a prime
black-quad suspect -- capture immediately after, not just settled.
VERDICT RULE: this defect is a LIGHTING-path artifact, so per the standing
capture rule it must be judged day AND night. Both arms are below.

steps._c: WITNESS FIRST. If the mission has no animatable building this
steps.__c: FAILS, and that failure is the finding ('cannot reproduce under
steps.___c: harness') -- not a reason to run arms that prove nothing.

steps._c: Freeze first: with movers pinned the frame differs ONLY by the
steps.__c: building's own animation, so a diff is attributable.

steps._c: ROUTE 1 -- setGesture. Replace 32771/1 with a real id + a gesture
Prove it actually LEFT the static batch. The ack reports intent;
steps.__c: this reports the world. staticNow=0 is the whole point.

steps._c: ROUTE 2 -- the damage SHAPE SWAP, a different invalidation route.
